Minecraft Modpack

A custom Minecraft zombie apocalypse modpack built around Create and The Factory Must Grow.

Overview

The goal was to create a progression-focused survival experience where technology gradually develops from basic machinery into advanced industrial systems.

Technologies

  • Minecraft 1.20.1
  • Forge
  • KubeJS
  • Create
  • The Factory Must Grow

What I worked on

I designed the progression system and used KubeJS to integrate different mods together.

I also created custom recipes and adjusted existing systems to make the mods work together as a cohesive experience.
